facts.fact: NASRDA's Nigeria customised CropWatch platform, built with the Chinese Academy of Sciences' AIRCAS under an MoU of 4 July 2022, offers NDVI, biomass, VCI, temperature and precipitation deliverables downloadable at national, state and local government level, though NASRDA says other components are still to be completed.
NASRDA says it has participated in publishing the quarterly CropWatch bulletin on crop production including Nigeria since the last quarter of 2021, with 7 editions to the date of the workshop.
